newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise again on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise again on tight supply.

text.p: ARA bunker prices again rose as prompt supply from refineries in Rotterdam appeared tight, but other European prices were steady on Monday, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was up $1/$2 a tonne to $125 fob as one major in particular was unable to deliver bunkers this week. Supply at another major was also somewhat low.
However, demand was not high, with shipowners willing to sit out. Enquiries in the ARA area totalled about 10,000 tonnes, but not all resulted in deals.
"Demand is pretty poor. If it wasn't for (short-term) supply problems, then prices would have dipped," a trader said.
Hamburg prices were steady, leaving little difference between ARA and German bunkers. Suppliers said there was one large short, but little else.
Mediterranean prices were largely unchanged and bunker demand steady to poor.
However, Egyptian bunkers firmed with a modest rise of demand.
